name: The Bell Thief
objective: A second Frostbell has surfaced — in the hands of a thief who stole it from the Echo Cult and now sells protection to the villages.
intro: The thief has hung the bell above the old camp's cages like a trophy. It rings in the wind, and the wind sounds wrong.
dialogue: Bell Thief: "Found it first. Found it fair."
Bell Thief (defeated): "Take it, then. It's just one bell. There are five more."
lore_discovery: The thief stole the bell from a chapel in the hills — the first confirmed sighting of the Echo Cult.
